question: The Mishras of Bettiah Gharana, renowned for Dhrupad singing, are associated with which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Mishras of Bettiah Gharana** are a prominent lineage of the **Dhrupad singing tradition**, which is one of the oldest and most profound forms of Indian classical music.
 
• The Bettiah Gharana is deeply rooted in the state of **Bihar**, specifically in the **town of Bettiah**, located in the West Champaran district.
 
• **Dhrupad** is a genre of Hindustani classical music with origins in ancient Indian temples. The Bettiah Gharana has played a significant role in preserving and promoting this art form.
